en: The study evaluates the effectiveness of the proposed system.
zh: 研究分析所提出系统的实际效果。
why: 动作措辞不同，但研究对象和效果评估内容一致

en: The report describes the major experimental findings.
zh: 报告介绍了主要实验结果。

en: The final submission contains a cover page, an abstract and a bibliography.
zh: 最终提交材料应包含封面、摘要和参考文献目录。
why: 三项内容一致；描述性 vs 规范性文风不构成业务冲突

en: The report may contain supplementary tables.
zh: 报告必须包含补充表格。
why: 可选升级成必须是实质义务差异

en: The abstract must summarize objectives, methodology, and conclusions.
zh: 摘要应概述研究目标与研究方法。

en: The manuscript includes an introduction, methods, results, and a discussion.
zh: 论文应包含引言、方法、结果和讨论。
why: 四项完整；描述与要求文风允许不同

en: Dataset Alpha was used for training, whereas Dataset Beta was reserved for evaluation.
zh: 数据集Alpha用于训练，数据集Beta用于评估。

en: Dataset Alpha was used for training, whereas Dataset Beta was reserved for evaluation.

en: The main text must be no longer than 12 pages, excluding appendices.
zh: 正文不超过12页，附录不计入。
why: 上限与附录例外均保持

zh: 正文不得少于12页，且附录计入。
